workload.description: Normalize a syntax node with many children that require invisible-parenthesis checks.

validation.details: Ran natively with Python 3.12 in an isolated pinned Black checkout installed editable in a temporary virtual environment at sizes 1, 2, 4, 8, and 16; correctness assertions passed and marker_probe observed the pinned linegen target.

tests.coverage_note: Loads the pinned source file, asserts its resolved path, exercises normalize_invisible_parens with bounded input, and verifies entry into the empty region marker.
